recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a current terminology page later renders without the shared navbar logos, or if a separate THO/UTG issue is filed for terminology content outside this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-27825 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction asking that logos display on Terminology pages; the original example was http://build.fhir.org/v3/orderableDrugForm/cs.html.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-27825. The Jira assignee marked it applied in 2022 after reviewing current build.fhir.org terminology pages and noting that the original v3/orderableDrugForm URL was no longer valid due to terminology page restructuring.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2020-06-22 record FHIR-27825 as a technical correction approved 9-0-0. Current CodeSystem and ValueSet templates include tools/templates/newnavbar.html, which references the FHIR and HL7 logo assets. Current CI-build terminology pages and those logo assets return 200, while the old v3/orderableDrugForm/cs.html URL returns 404. Community searches found no directly relevant conflicting Zulip discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source and rendered build already satisfy the issue, and editing the obsolete v3 page path would not correct the current FHIR build.
